text:
Nora L.: Quick flag 1: QuantumScale invoice QS-2026-112 for $6,430 arrived but header shows vendor name 'QuantumScales Inc' (typo) and no PO. Vendor says due in 6 days. AP can't match without PO. Can procurement check if PO exists or ask for reissue?
Invoices Bot: New invoice: QS-2026-112 uploaded  amount $6,430  status: unmatched. Link: https://accounting.redwood.internal/invoices/QS-2026-112
Elliot (Procurement): Searching POs... we have PO-85501 for QuantumScale reserved nodes $6k. Looks like this invoice includes a $430 support add-on. Also vendor name mismatch could break vendor master match. @QuantumScale Billing can you confirm legal entity and add PO-85501 to header?
QuantumScale Billing: Hi all  thanks for flagging. Legal entity is "QuantumScale LLC" (not QuantumScales Inc) 1. Invoice generator pulled an old alias. We can reissue QS-2026-112-R1 with corrected vendor name and PO-85501 on the header, and an explicit line for support ($430). Want us to include GL mapping?
Rina (AP): If vendor name matches vendor master and PO on the header we can auto-match $6,000 to PO-85501. The $430 support line will need cost owner approval. Please include remittance and bank reference on the reissue so treasury can confirm routing.
Anika (Finance Manager): FYI anything with misc services >$250 needs finance review. Please map support line to GL 5410-SUPPORT and cost center infra-sys. Once matched route to me for approval.
Elliot (Procurement): I'll add a supplemental PO if needed (PO-85501-S1) for the $430 to avoid a manual hold. QuantumScale, can you include both PO-85501 and PO-85501-S1 on the reissue?
QuantumScale Billing: Yes we can include both. We'll upload QS-2026-112-R1 today with vendor name corrected to "QuantumScale LLC", header PO-85501 and PO-85501-S1, line-item breakdown, GL field, and current remittance details.
Invoices Bot: Invoice QS-2026-112-R1 uploaded  amount $6,430  status: pending match. Link: https://accounting.redwood.internal/invoices/QS-2026-112-R1
Rina (AP): Received. Matched $6,000 to PO-85501. Routing $430 support line to Anika for finance approval. Vendor name now matches vendor master.
Anika (Finance Manager): Reviewed 1. Approve $430 to GL 5410-SUPPORT, cost center infra-sys. Clear for payment.
Rina (AP): Scheduling payment on next AP run. Noted vendor corrected legal name; I'll update vendor master record to "QuantumScale LLC".
Elliot (Procurement): I'll confirm with vendor to ensure future invoices come from the corrected entity and include PO fields when add-ons apply.
Nora L.: Filing case: "QuantumScale invoice had wrong vendor alias and omitted PO; reissued QS-2026-112-R1 with vendor corrected, PO-85501 + PO-85501-S1, support $430 mapped to GL 5410-SUPPORT; routed to Anika; payment scheduled." :white_check_mark:
QuantumScale Billing: Thanks for the quick turnaround. We'll update our billing export to always emit legal_entity and po_number fields.
